questions.explain: The predictor is an early-warning system: tune for high recall (≥85%) so precursors trigger readiness checks, since a false alarm costs an investigation while a missed prediction costs an outage.
options: Tune for maximum precision so alerts are rare
Tune for high recall (≥85%) — false alarms cost a readiness check, missed predictions cost an outage
Use the default 0.5 threshold without validation
Tune for the highest possible F1 score regardless of cost asymmetry

questions.explain: RPO estimate = unhardened log (log_send_queue_size) divided by the log send rate (log_send_rate) — the data loss if the primary died right now.

Log send queue size divided by the log send rate
The number of replicas times the commit interval
Average transaction duration over the last hour
